_sections.common: 1. Shared mission dialogue (used across multiple NPC handlers)

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.notReady: Return when you are ready for this task.
common.costelloNoFurtherMissions: I have no further mission for you. Perhaps the King has work for you.

serpentine_tower.title: Serpentine Basement Quest
serpentine_tower.requiresMeetingWithTesha: First bring me the scarab coin from the desert sands. Then we may speak of other matters.
serpentine_tower.prompt: There is a matter I would ask of you, Player. Beneath the Serpentine Tower, in the basement, there is a lever. I need someone to go and use it — but be prepared for danger. Will you undertake this task?
serpentine_tower.accept: Descend to the Serpentine Tower basement and use the lever. Be warned — great peril awaits those who are not ready.
serpentine_tower.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: will you undertake this task?
serpentine_tower.alreadyActive: You have already accepted this task. Go to the Serpentine Tower basement and use the lever — but be prepared for danger.
serpentine_tower.alreadyCompleted: You have already braved what lies beneath the Serpentine Tower. My thanks.
serpentine_tower.putridChamberReturnObjective: Return to Tesha in Darama Oasis to receive your reward.
serpentine_tower.putridChamberVictoryToast: You survived The Cursed Chamber. Return to Tesha in Darama Oasis.
serpentine_tower.battleVictory: You survived the horrors of The Cursed Chamber. Return to Tesha in Darama Oasis.
serpentine_tower.battleDefeat: The creatures of The Cursed Chamber were too strong.
teshaRewardLines: You have braved The Cursed Chamber. Take this Scorpion Sceptre — may it serve you well, Player.
A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it.
serpentine_tower.destroyFieldRuneHint: The destroy field rune you seek lies upon the corpse of a magic elf, Player.
serpentine_tower.destroyFieldRuneAlreadyHave: You already carry the destroy field rune, Player. Use it upon the energy fields that block your path.
serpentine_tower.objectiveLine2: Use the lever and be prepared for danger.
serpentine_tower.hint: Tesha spoke of a lever in the Serpentine Tower basement.

king_honeyflower.title: Retrieve the Honeyflower
king_honeyflower.prompt: I require honey for my tea. Journey to Honeyflower Tower and retrieve a honeyflower for me. Will you help?
king_honeyflower.accept: Go to Honeyflower Tower and pick the honeyflower. Return to me when you have it.
king_honeyflower.complete: Splendid! My tea shall be sweet once more. Here are 50 guild coins for your trouble.
king_honeyflower.missingItem: You claim yes but carry no honeyflower. Return when you have picked one from Honeyflower Tower.
king_honeyflower.keepSearching: Then journey to Honeyflower Tower and retrieve the honeyflower.
king_honeyflower.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you brought the honeyflower?
king_honeyflower.alreadyCompleted: You already brought me a honeyflower. My thanks.
king_honeyflower.alreadyActive: You are already on this task. Retrieve the honeyflower from Honeyflower Tower and return to me.
king_honeyflower.objectiveLine2: Pick the honeyflower and return it to King Tibianus.
king_honeyflower.hint: Right-click the glowing flower tile in Honeyflower Tower.

king_crossing_the_line.title: Fastest Bishop in Carlin
king_crossing_the_line.prompt: Ah, a game of wits! Travel to City Boardgames and station mages upon the marked tiles of the board, then win a battle with them so placed. Will you prove the fastest bishop in Carlin?
king_crossing_the_line.accept: Excellent. Go to City Boardgames, place mages on the glowing tiles, and win a match. Return to me when it is done.
king_crossing_the_line.askForItem: Have you completed the chess drill at City Boardgames?
king_crossing_the_line.complete: Splendid play! Truly the fastest bishop in Carlin. Here are 50 guild coins for your trouble.
king_crossing_the_line.missingItem: You claim yes, yet I see no proof of a proper victory. Station mages on the marked tiles, win the battle, then return.
king_crossing_the_line.keepSearching: Then go to City Boardgames and complete the chess drill with mages on the marked tiles.
king_crossing_the_line.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you completed the chess drill?
king_crossing_the_line.alreadyCompleted: You already proved yourself at the board. Well done.
king_crossing_the_line.alreadyActive: You are already on this chess drill. Station mages on the marked tiles at City Boardgames, win, and return to me.
king_crossing_the_line.objectiveLine1: Travel to City Boardgames and station mages on the marked tiles.
king_crossing_the_line.objectiveLine2: Win a battle with mages on those tiles, then return to King Tibianus.
king_crossing_the_line.hint: Only creatures with the Mage category count on the glowing tiles.

king_copper_key.title: Retrieve King Tibianus belongings
king_copper_key.prompt: Glad you asked! One of my guards lost my precious copper key down in the mines. Would you be able to help me get it back?
king_copper_key.accept: Thank you! Take this map to help guide you to the mines. Let me know when you've retrieved it!
king_copper_key.complete: Splendid! You found my key. The mission is complete.
king_copper_key.missingKey: You claim yes but carry no key? Begone!
king_copper_key.keepSearching: Then keep searching and return when you have it.
king_copper_key.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you found my key?
king_copper_key.alreadyCompleted: You already completed this mission. Excellent work, my subject.
king_copper_key.alreadyActive: You are already on this mission. Bring me back the copper key!
king_copper_key.notExperiencedEnough: That task is beyond you for now. Come back when you are more experienced.
king_copper_key.objectiveLine1: A guard lost the king's copper key deep in the mines.
king_copper_key.objectiveLine2: Find the copper key and return it to King Tibianus.
king_copper_key.hint: It seems as I must steal it from the angry Dwarfs as they probably won't let me have it without resistance.

king_red_dragon.title: Stock the Royal Forge
king_red_dragon.prompt: Brave subject, I need supplies for my smiths: bring me 30 red dragon scales and 30 red dragon leathers. Will you help me?
king_red_dragon.accept: Excellent. Return once you have the materials.
king_red_dragon.askForItems: Have you brought the red dragon materials?
king_red_dragon.complete: Well done! The royal forge will thrive with these materials.
king_red_dragon.missingItems: You claim yes but lack the materials. Do not waste my time.
king_red_dragon.keepSearching: Then keep hunting dragons and return when you have them.
king_red_dragon.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you brought the materials?
king_red_dragon.alreadyCompleted: You already completed this task. Impressive work.
king_red_dragon.alreadyActive: You are already on this task. Bring me the materials.
king_red_dragon.hint: Hunt red dragons and skin them for scales and leather.

king_letter_al_dee.title: Letter from Al Dee
king_letter_al_dee.prompt: Ah, a letter from Al Dee! That old rope merchant has been trying to get my attention for weeks. Can you return this letter to him when you visit him?
king_letter_al_dee.accept: Take this letter back to Al Dee. He usually hangs around somewhere in Rookgaard. Good luck on your adventure!
king_letter_al_dee.acceptNoLetter: I'm afraid the letter has been stolen by monsters in Rookgaard! You'll need to defeat them to find it. Once you have the letter, bring it to me and I'll stamp it for you to deliver to Al Dee.
king_letter_al_dee.askForLetter: Have you returned the letter to Al Dee?
king_letter_al_dee.complete: Well done! Al Dee was most pleased. Perhaps you'll find him useful in your future adventures.
king_letter_al_dee.missingLetter: You claim to have returned it but I see no proof. Find Al Dee and complete his task!
king_letter_al_dee.keepSearching: Then find Al Dee in Rookgaard and return his letter.
king_letter_al_dee.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you returned the letter to Al Dee?
king_letter_al_dee.alreadyCompleted: You already helped Al Dee. Perhaps you should visit his shop again.
king_letter_al_dee.alreadyActive: You are already on this task. Find Al Dee and return his letter!
king_letter_al_dee.objectiveLine1: Find the Letter from Al Dee.
king_letter_al_dee.objectiveLine2: Return the stamped letter to Al Dee.
king_letter_al_dee.hint: Defeat monsters in Rookgaard to find the letter, then bring it to King Tibianus to get it stamped.

king_monks_study.title: The Monks Study
king_monks_study.prompt: I see you carry the Holy Tible – you have proven yourself in the search for the Light. Now I ask you to seek out Costello within the White Raven Monastery. He is a learned man and may have wisdom that serves the crown. Will you undertake this task?
king_monks_study.accept: Go to the White Raven Monastery and seek out Costello. Return to me when you have news.
king_monks_study.complete: Excellent work. Costello has long been a friend of the crown.
king_monks_study.missingItem: You claim yes but I have had no word from the monastery. Find Costello and speak with him.
king_monks_study.keepSearching: Then journey to the White Raven Monastery and search for Costello.
king_monks_study.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you found Costello?
king_monks_study.alreadyCompleted: You have already completed this task. My thanks.
king_monks_study.alreadyActive: You are already on this task. Seek Costello in the White Raven Monastery.
king_monks_study.objectiveLine1: Travel to the White Raven Monastery.
king_monks_study.objectiveLine2: Search for Costello within the monastery.
king_monks_study.hint: The White Raven Monastery lies somewhere beyond the realm. Look for Costello there.
king_monks_study.costelloHolyTibleAsk: The King has sent you. Do you have the Holy Tible with you? I need to see it to complete your study here.
king_monks_study.costelloHolyTibleMissing: You do not have the Holy Tible. Return when you have it.
king_monks_study.costelloHolyTibleReturn: Return when you have the Holy Tible.
king_monks_study.costelloHolyTibleError: Something went wrong. Return when you have the Holy Tible.
king_monks_study.costelloStudyComplete: Thank you. Your study here is complete. Here are {coins} guild coins as a reward.

king_scarab_coin.title: Lost in the Sands
king_scarab_coin.prompt: Rumour speaks of a lost valuable buried somewhere in the desert sands of Darama. Journey to the oasis and search the dunes — will you undertake this hunt?
king_scarab_coin.accept: Search the desert sands of Darama Oasis for the lost valuable. Dig where the lone sand tiles lie.
king_scarab_coin.askForCoin: Have you found the lost valuable in the desert?
king_scarab_coin.complete: Splendid! You unearthed what was lost in the sands. Seek out Tesha in the oasis — she may know its worth.
king_scarab_coin.missingCoin: You claim yes but carry nothing from the sands. Return when you have dug up the valuable.
king_scarab_coin.keepSearching: Then keep searching the desert and return when you find it.
king_scarab_coin.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you found the lost valuable?
king_scarab_coin.alreadyCompleted: You have already completed the hunt in the desert sands. My thanks.
king_scarab_coin.alreadyActive: You are already searching the desert sands of Darama Oasis for the lost valuable.
king_scarab_coin.objectiveLine1: Search the desert sands of Darama Oasis for a lost valuable.
king_scarab_coin.objectiveLine2: Show the scarab coin to Tesha in Darama Oasis.
king_scarab_coin.hint: Lore tells that the valuable was lost while fighting where the stairs are that lead to Port Hope.
king_scarab_coin.teshaAskForCoin: Have you brought me a scarab coin from the desert? Show it to me if you have one.
king_scarab_coin.teshaNoCoin: You do not have a scarab coin with you.
king_scarab_coin.teshaAlreadyCompleted: You have already shown me a scarab coin. May enlightenment guide you, Player.
teshaCompleteLines: A scarab coin from the desert sands! The priests say they are sacred beings, although ... <whispers>I find them scary!
They are not mere curios — these coins are offerings for the tomb warps. The priests use them to open the paths to ascension.
Thank you for bringing it to me, Player. I shall keep it safe.
king_scarab_coin.teshaCompleteCoinLine: Here are {coins} guild coins for your trouble, Player.

al_dee_fishing_gold.title: Fishing for gold
al_dee_fishing_gold.prompt: Ah, adventurer! I dropped my Small Axe in the waters of a cave while being hunted by minotaurs and goblins. Will you help me retrieve it?
al_dee_fishing_gold.accept: Thank you! I'll be waiting here for my Small Axe.
al_dee_fishing_gold.askForItem: Have you found my Small Axe?
al_dee_fishing_gold.complete: My Small Axe! You found it! Here's a Light Shovel as a reward for your help.
al_dee_fishing_gold.missingItem: You claim yes but I see no Small Axe. Return when you have it!
al_dee_fishing_gold.keepSearching: Then keep searching for my axe and return when you find it.
al_dee_fishing_gold.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you found my Small Axe?
al_dee_fishing_gold.alreadyCompleted: You already helped me find my Small Axe. Thank you again!
al_dee_fishing_gold.alreadyActive: You're already helping me find my Small Axe. Bring it back when you find it!
al_dee_fishing_gold.objectiveLine1: Find Al Dee's Small Axe in the waters of a cave.
al_dee_fishing_gold.objectiveLine2: Return the Small Axe to Al Dee.
al_dee_fishing_gold.hint: Search underwater areas or caves where minotaurs and goblins roam.

al_dee_golden_rope.title: The search for the Light
al_dee_golden_rope.prompt: Ah, adventurer! I've lost my precious elvenhair rope to those tricky elves. It's said to have magical properties that can lead one to great treasures. Will you help me find it?
al_dee_golden_rope.accept: Excellent! I'll be waiting here for my elvenhair rope. Please return it when you find it!
al_dee_golden_rope.askForItem: Have you found my elvenhair rope?
al_dee_golden_rope.complete: My elvenhair rope! You found it! Thank you for your help. Here, take this Holy Tible as a reward for your bravery!
al_dee_golden_rope.missingItem: You claim yes but I see no elvenhair rope. Return when you have it!
al_dee_golden_rope.keepSearching: Then keep searching for my rope and return when you find it.
al_dee_golden_rope.answerYesNo: Answer yes or no: have you found my elvenhair rope?
al_dee_golden_rope.alreadyCompleted: You already helped me find my elvenhair rope. Thank you again!
al_dee_golden_rope.alreadyActive: You're already helping me find my elvenhair rope. Bring it back when you find it!
al_dee_golden_rope.objectiveLine1: Find Al Dee's elvenhair rope that was taken by elves.
al_dee_golden_rope.objectiveLine2: Return the elvenhair rope to Al Dee.
al_dee_golden_rope.hint: Search areas where elves are known to roam.
al_dee_golden_rope.battleVictory: Mornenion was slain. You found Elvenhair Rope.
al_dee_golden_rope.battleDefeat: Mornenions powers were too strong for you.

costello_queen_banshees.title: The Queen Of The Banshees
costello_queen_banshees.prompt: There is a matter I would ask of you. The seven seals of Ghostlands – I need you to complete them and return to me when you have done so. I will give you my diary; it may guide you. Will you undertake this task?
costello_queen_banshees.accept: Complete the seven seals of Ghostlands and return when you have done so.
costello_queen_banshees.complete: You have completed the seven seals of Ghostlands. The Queen Of The Banshees task is complete. You have received the Blessed Ankh. My thanks.
costello_queen_banshees.allSealsDoneHandIn: You have completed all seven seals. Return to me and say you are done when you wish to complete this task.
costello_queen_banshees.alreadyCompleted: You have already completed this task. My thanks.
costello_queen_banshees.alreadyActive: You have accepted my task. Complete the seven seals of Ghostlands and return when you have done so.
costello_queen_banshees.objectiveLine1: Complete the seven seals of Ghostlands.
costello_queen_banshees.objectiveLine2: Return to Castello when all seven have been completed.
costello_queen_banshees.rewardDescription: You see the engraving of a white raven on its surface.

follower_of_zathroth.title: The Follower of Zathroth
follower_of_zathroth.prompt: I have another matter for you. Take the Blessed Ankh you earned and bring it to my friend Wyda in the swamps of Venore. She has need of it. Will you go?
follower_of_zathroth.accept: Bring the Blessed Ankh to Wyda in the swamps of Venore. She will know what to do with it.
follower_of_zathroth.alreadyCompleted: You have already brought the Blessed Ankh to Wyda. My thanks.
follower_of_zathroth.alreadyActive: You must bring the Blessed Ankh to Wyda in the swamps of Venore.
follower_of_zathroth.objectiveLine1: Bring the Blessed Ankh to Wyda in the swamps of Venore.
follower_of_zathroth.objectiveLine2: Give the Blessed Ankh to Wyda to complete the task.
follower_of_zathroth.notReadyDecline: Return when you are ready to bring the Blessed Ankh to Wyda.
follower_of_zathroth.wydaHandInComplete: The Blessed Ankh! Yes, this is what I needed. You have done well. The matter Castello spoke of is complete.
follower_of_zathroth.wydaHandInCoinLine: Here are {coins} guild coins for your trouble.

mother_of_all_spiders.title: The Mother of All Spiders
mother_of_all_spiders.prompt: A new task? Very well. You must descend the secluded herb to find the mother of all spiders. Defeat it and return to me with the silk. Will you do this?
mother_of_all_spiders.accept: Descend the secluded herb, find the mother of all spiders, defeat it and bring me the silk.
mother_of_all_spiders.alreadyCompleted: You have already completed that task. My thanks.
mother_of_all_spiders.alreadyActive: You must descend the secluded herb, defeat the mother of all spiders and return with the silk.
mother_of_all_spiders.objectiveLine1: Descend the secluded herb and find the mother of all spiders.
mother_of_all_spiders.objectiveLine2: Defeat the mother of all spiders and return with the silk to Wyda.
mother_of_all_spiders.rewardDescription: It is made from fine spider silk.
mother_of_all_spiders.wydaSilkComplete: The silk! Excellent. I can make good use of this. Here, take this Spool of Yarn as thanks.
mother_of_all_spiders.wydaMissingSilk: You don't have the spider silk. Defeat the mother of all spiders in the secluded herb and return with the silk.
mother_of_all_spiders.battleVictory: The Old Widow was slain. You found Spider Silk.
mother_of_all_spiders.battleDefeat: The Old Widow was too strong.

apprentice_sheng.title: Apprentice Sheng
apprentice_sheng.prompt: Greetings, traveller. I am Apprentice Sheng. Will you hear me out?
apprentice_sheng.accept: Speak with Rookstayer in the Minotaur Mage Room.
apprentice_sheng.alreadyCompleted: You have already completed this task.
apprentice_sheng.alreadyActive: You have already spoken with Rookstayer.
apprentice_sheng.objectiveLine1: Help Rookstayer defeat Apprentice Sheng in the Minotaur Mage Room.
apprentice_sheng.objectiveLine2: Speak with Rookstayer after the battle for your reward.
apprentice_sheng.hint: After retrieving the honeyflower for King Tibianus, seek Rookstayer in the Minotaur Mage Room.

christmas_miracle.title: A Christmas Miracle
christmas_miracle.accept: Someone in Folda may be waiting for that list.
christmas_miracle.alreadyCompleted: You have already received your Christmas present.
christmas_miracle.alreadyActive: You are already on this Christmas quest.
christmas_miracle.objectiveLine1: You've found a wishlist. Ask Santa about this.
christmas_miracle.rewardDescription: Soft pink bunny slippers. A gift from Santa Claus.

completionSummaries.king_honeyflower: Retrieved a honeyflower from Honeyflower Tower for King Tibianus.
completionSummaries.king_crossing_the_line: Won a City Boardgames chess battle with mages stationed on the marked tiles for King Tibianus.
completionSummaries.king_copper_key: Returned the copper key to King Tibianus.
completionSummaries.king_red_dragon: Delivered 30 red dragon scales and 30 red dragon leathers to the royal forge.
completionSummaries.king_letter_al_dee: Returned the stamped letter to Al Dee in Rookgaard.
completionSummaries.king_monks_study: Found Costello at the White Raven Monastery.
completionSummaries.king_scarab_coin: Unearthed the scarab coin in the desert sands and showed it to Tesha in Darama Oasis.
completionSummaries.al_dee_fishing_gold: Retrieved Al Dee's Small Axe from the cave waters.
completionSummaries.costello_queen_banshees: Completed the seven seals of Ghostlands and returned to Castello.
completionSummaries.follower_of_zathroth: Brought the Blessed Ankh to Wyda in the swamps of Venore.
completionSummaries.mother_of_all_spiders: Descended the secluded herb, defeated the mother of all spiders, and returned the silk to Wyda.
completionSummaries.serpentine_tower: Used the lever in the Serpentine Tower basement and survived The Cursed Chamber.
completionSummaries.apprentice_sheng: Helped Rookstayer defeat Apprentice Sheng in the Minotaur Mage Room.
completionSummaries.christmas_miracle: Received a Christmas present from Santa Claus.

Find the lever in the Throne of the Destroyer to complete the seal.
